title: Publish is offered only for a goal with a landed commit
description:
SPIDR child 2 of task-a8317bb46e36476e8399c611b41d9612. dependsOn child 1 (task-19d2329c25934099b2ff10086987d1c5). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the `repository.publish` offer gate on `/affordances/read`. Nothing else.

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:141-147 mints `offer(input, "repository.publish", publish:<goalId>)` for EVERY goal whose lifecycle is EXECUTION_ENABLED, CLOSING or COMPLETED - even with zero landed commits (seen live on UnAI 2026-09-04: a PUBLISH card over "No node of this goal is landed as a commit yet"). `offersForGoal` works from `PlanningOfferInput` facts and has no store; affordance-read.ts (:112 config.store, :263-266 composes the input) is where a landing fact is read.
- Landing facts: `readReviewLedgers(store, projectId, subjectRefs).landings` (apps/daemon/src/review/review-read-model.ts:287, :274-279) yields `LandingReceiptV1` per bare node key with `outcome: COMMITTED | REFUSED` (repository/landing-receipt-contracts.ts:56-67); the goal's node keys come from its activated graph (the same walk the coverage read uses: document-coverage-read.ts readActive).
- SHARED FILES: goal-close child task-8145137ca3c144f0878deb83d05bab63 adds a readiness fact to the SAME two files (affordance-planning-offers.ts + affordance-read.ts). If that row is WORKING or REVIEW when this row is claimed, `moe.report_blocked` with blockedOnTaskIds = [task-8145137ca3c144f0878deb83d05bab63] and wait - never edit those files concurrently; when it has landed, ADD a second fact beside its readiness fact (same shape, one line in the ladder).
- Pinned consumers of the publish offer: affordance-planning-offers.test.ts:101-104 (expects ["goal.close","repository.publish"] once execution is enabled), affordance-read-planning.test.ts (goal.close/publish targets), affordance-read.test.ts:454/:498 offer roster, the board header's publish link (keys on the offer - memory board-screen-landed-2026-09-04), control-room goal-publish.tsx (renders on the offer), tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts (contract-less chain) - re-measure each and name every one the plan touches.

FEATURE: `repository.publish` is offered for a goal only when at least one node of that goal carries a landing receipt with outcome COMMITTED; a goal with landings all REFUSED, or none, gets no publish offer (the card then renders nothing - child 3). Contract-less/seed goals follow the same rule (a landing is a landing); the pinned fixtures that expect the offer right after activation are updated to land a commit first, each named.
definitionOfDone: Over a REAL store: `/affordances/read` carries no `repository.publish` offer for an enabled goal with no landing receipt; after one node's landing receipt COMMITTED is recorded (recordLandingReceipt, repository/landing-ledger.ts:153) the offer appears targeting `publish:<goalId>`; a goal whose only landing is REFUSED (NOTHING_TO_COMMIT) stays unoffered; assert absent -> present -> absent transitions by reading the surface.

Every pinned consumer updated and named: affordance-planning-offers.test.ts:101-104, affordance-read.test.ts:454/:498, affordance-read-planning.test.ts arms that list publish, and tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts if it asserts the publish card before a landing (`pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted); the offer roster arms stay set-equality (never subset).

The landing fact is added beside child task-8145137c's readiness fact in affordance-read.ts / affordance-planning-offers.ts only after that row has landed (`git log main --grep "Moe-Task: task-8145137ca3c144f0878deb83d05bab63"` = 1+ line quoted in the step note); if it has not landed at claim time the row is BLOCKED on it, never edited concurrently.

Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`; both production files stay under 400 lines (affordance-read.ts is 422 today - if the fact pushes it further, extract the fact readers into a sibling module rather than growing it; `wc -l` quoted).
taskRails: SHARED-WORKTREE ORDERING: affordance-planning-offers.ts and affordance-read.ts are also owned by task-8145137c (goal-close readiness); report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds while it is in flight; extend additively after it lands.
OFFER ROSTER TESTS ARE BIDIRECTIONAL: served offers == expected set, never a subset (global rail 9); every fixture that loses or gains the publish offer is named in the plan.
Refusals/offers assert exact sets; mutate to prove red (global rail 1). <=250 lines per production source, hard stop 400 (affordance-read.ts already at 422: extract, do not grow).

(c) Baseline: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` at the merge-base, count line + failing files quoted.

THE LANDING FACT, test first, over a REAL store. Create apps/daemon/src/repository/goal-landing-facts.test.ts then apps/daemon/src/repository/goal-landing-facts.ts (<= 90 lines) + bridge goal-landing-facts.js (`export * from "./goal-landing-facts.ts";`). Export `goalHasLandedCommit(store, projectId, goalId, folded?: DurableLedger): boolean` - node keys = the goal's activated graph content from `activeCompiledGraphs(store, projectId, LANDABLE_LIFECYCLES, folded)` filtered by `goalRef === goalId` (LANDABLE_LIFECYCLES = EXECUTION_ENABLED, CLOSING, COMPLETED - the same set the ladder offers publish for); no graph or no nodes -> false; `readReviewLedgers(store, projectId, new Set(nodeKeys)).landings` -> true iff some receipt has `outcome === "COMMITTED"`; a thrown store -> false (fail closed: no offer). Arms (fixtures from ../goals/goal-closure-test-fixtures.js: openStore/driveThrough/PROJECT_ID/GOAL_ID via ../bootstrap/bootstrap-test-fixtures.js, seedReviewAcceptance, seedLandingReceipt): (1) an enabled goal with no landing -> false; (2) after `seedReviewAcceptance(store, "node-1")` + `seedLandingReceipt(store, "node-1", "COMMITTED")` -> true; (3) a goal whose only landing is REFUSED (`seedLandingReceipt(store, "node-1", { refusalCode: "NOTHING_TO_COMMIT" })`) -> false; (4) a landing on a node key the goal's graph does NOT carry (seed on "node-stranger" after opening a review acceptance for it if the fixture requires one) -> false (the walk is goal-scoped); (5) a goal in DRAFT/PLAN_REVIEW (before activation) -> false; (6) a store closed before the read -> false, no throw. Gate from apps/daemon: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/repository/goal-landing-facts.test.ts` (count line quoted).

THE OFFER GATE, test first. (1) apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.test.ts: the `offersFor`/`resolutionFor` helper's PlanningOfferInput gains `landedCommit: () => false` (default) beside 8145137c's `closeReadiness`; RE-AIM :101-108: with the default the EXECUTION_ENABLED/CLOSING roster is exactly ["goal.close"] (set-equality; the publish offer is gone until a commit lands) and COMPLETED is []; NEW arms: `landedCommit: () => true` -> EXECUTION_ENABLED/CLOSING ["goal.close", "repository.publish"] with the publish target `publish:<GOAL_ID>` (:105-107's assertions move here) and COMPLETED ["repository.publish"]; the fact is consulted only for those three lifecycles (a spy counts zero calls for DRAFT and compiler-lane goals); with 8145137c's `closeReadiness: () => "NOT_READY"` AND `landedCommit: () => true` -> ["repository.publish"] only (the two gates are independent). Run red. (2) apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts (<= 200 lines): `PlanningOfferInput` gains `readonly landedCommit: (goalId: string) => boolean`; the publish minting becomes `const publish = input.landedCommit(goal.goalId) ? [offer(input, "repository.publish", `publish:${goal.goalId}`)] : [];` and the three returns spread it (`[...close, ...publish]`), with a comment: publishing is offered only once at least one node of the goal is landed as a commit - a goal with nothing to push gets no PUBLISH card (seen live on UnAI 2026-09-04). (3) apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-read.ts (:264-269; +2 lines on a pre-existing over-cap file, record the size): `landedCommit: (goalId) => goalHasLandedCommit(config.store, config.projectId, goalId, ledger)` (import from ../repository/goal-landing-facts.js; the folded `ledger` is the one already read at :263 - never a second fold). (4) Real-store surface arms in goal-landing-facts.test.ts (second describe, `createAffordancePort({...})` over the seed world - copy the port config affordance-read.test.ts uses, cite the lines): the surface carries NO `repository.publish` offer for the enabled goal; after `seedReviewAcceptance` + `seedLandingReceipt(... "COMMITTED")` the offer appears targeting `publish:<GOAL_ID>` (assert with set-equality on `commandKind@target` over the whole offer list, so a duplicate or a stray offer reds); a fresh store whose only landing is REFUSED stays unoffered; the goal.close offer's presence is unchanged across all three (8145137c's NO_CONTRACT invariant holds for the seed world). Gate from apps/daemon: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/http/affordance-planning-offers.test.ts src/http/affordance-read.test.ts src/http/affordance-read-planning.test.ts src/repository/goal-landing-facts.test.ts` (count lines quoted; the pinned rosters at affordance-read.test.ts:454/:498 and affordance-read-planning.test.ts:290/:514-545 green UNCHANGED).

From the repo root: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (quote `Test Files N passed` / `Tests N passed`), `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` (the publish card renders on the offer - no control-room source changes, but its tests build their own surface frames; count line quoted, must be unchanged), `pnpm typecheck` (quote the `$ tsc` echo), `pnpm test:e2e:browser` from PowerShell (board-chain.spec.ts asserts the goal.close card, never the publish card - count line quoted). Record the red lines + restore proofs in the step note (< 4500 chars).

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW + COMPLETE. Load the adversarial-self-review skill: a goal landed, then its node REPLANNED into a successor goal - the original keeps its committed landing and stays publishable (correct: the commit exists); a landing receipt whose subjectRef names the node but whose `commit` is null with outcome COMMITTED (malformed) - decodeLandingReceiptBytes refuses it upstream, confirm with one arm if cheap; the surface read now performs one graph walk + one review-ledger walk per enabled/closing/completed goal per poll - measure a 3-goal surface read before/after and record it (the ledger fold is shared, the review walk is per goal: if it exceeds ~50 ms on the fixture store, batch the subjects of all goals into ONE readReviewLedgers call and note it); a goal whose lifecycle is COMPLETED but never landed (Foundation seed) - no publish offer (accepted; the seed never pushes). Then `moe.add_comment` on child 3 (task-e6000b57fd374f78ba074b9f0f0f2c67): the publish offer now appears only after a landed commit, so its Publish control renders nothing for an unlanded goal (name the surface arm). (2) Reusing the goal-close readiness module for landings - rejected: coverage readiness (goals/) and landing facts (repository/) are different ledgers and different consumers. (3) Blocking mid-flight on 8145137c as the description said - replaced by a dependsOn FIELD (set at plan time), so the runtime withholds the WORKING claim until both prerequisites are DONE and the shared-file hazard never arises. (4) Gating the publish COMMAND as well - out of scope: repository.publish's own preconditions belong to the publish command's owner; this row gates the OFFER only.
